evidence.text: Implemented work.py evaluate(request, policy). Rows are processed in order with per-row error priority id, amount, unit, duplicate. IDs must be nonempty strings; amounts must be finite nonnegative int/float excluding bool; omitted unit defaults to policy.base_unit and supplied/default unit must exist in policy.units. Under unique=true, every row with a valid ID reserves that ID even if amount/unit later fails, so a later occurrence can be duplicate; duplicate is reported only after amount and unit checks. Successful rows convert amount by policy.units[unit] and report base_unit. Any error empties all records. Inputs remain unchanged. report.json equals evaluations of current requests.json under policy.json. Local boundary checks passed for conversion/defaulting, input immutability, invalid and nonfinite amounts, error priority, and duplicate tracking.
